# Over-split Over Over-merge in Entity Slug Minting

If a natural-key derived entity slug collides with existing slugs, a deterministic '-2', '-3', ... suffix is appended, ensuring that entities are never merged unless identity is certain.

To favor creating new entities rather than merging potentially distinct ones, consistent with the system's bias towards avoiding accidental data merging (as articulated in ADR-004 and related decision points).
